versions.changelog:
Version 1.1.0

- No changes detected in this release.
- All features and usage remain the same.

- Initial release of the weather skill.
- Provides current weather and forecasts using wttr.in (primary) and Open-Meteo (fallback).
- No API key required; uses curl to fetch data.
- Supports quick one-liners, detailed formats, and both text and image outputs.
- Fallback to Open-Meteo for structured JSON responses.
